## What this section covers

This section presents **Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs)** with a focus on **shell-aligned implementation**, **traceability to ADaM/SAP intent**, **QC review**, and **delivery readiness**.
:::

## Overview

TLFs are the visible outputs of statistical analysis and must balance scientific clarity, formatting precision, and reproducibility. My TLF approach emphasizes:

- **Shell alignment** (SAP/TLF shell fidelity)
- **Traceability** (output → ADaM → derivation/source intent)
- **Review readiness** (clear labeling, consistency, and formatting)
- **QC-first execution** (content, logic, and presentation checks)

The goal is to deliver outputs that are accurate, interpretable, and submission/reporting ready.

### TLF Overview

## Representative TLF contributions

- Translate shell specifications into reproducible output programs
- Validate consistency between outputs, populations, and ADaM inputs
- Organize output packages for efficient medical/statistical review
- Support delivery with traceable, QC-reviewed outputs

## Working style

My TLF workflow is **shell-driven and reviewer-focused**:

- Start from shell intent and analysis definitions
- Standardize formatting and output conventions
- Build QC checks into production and review cycles
- Ensure outputs are easy to trace and interpret
